mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS drops > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO drops > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 3% YoY, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% QoQ and retail sales (RSAFS) decline by more than 2% MoM, the combination signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < 1% and RSAFS MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1%.
